title: Stale devices
hints: Subtracting two dates gives a timedelta; its .days attribute is an int you can compare with max_days.
Shape: [d["hostname"] for d in devices if <condition>]. Put the None check first, joined with `or`, so the subtraction never sees None.
The condition is `d["last_seen"] is None or (today - d["last_seen"]).days > max_days`; strictly greater keeps the boundary fresh.
